title: Experience the Enhanced Spyglass
summary: We're excited to announce the official availability of Spyglass, delivering a refined and powerful tool designed to elevate your productivity and streamline your workflow.

title: Enhanced File Control in Editor
summary: Take complete command over your embedded files with new tools that allow you to easily manage, upload, and customize their appearance directly within the editor.

title: Unveiling the Noeko Public Roadmap
summary: We're excited to introduce our new public roadmap, offering full transparency into our past accomplishments, current priorities, and future vision.

title: Enhanced Checkboxes
summary: We've significantly upgraded our checkboxes, making them easier to click, visually modern, and fully draggable for a smoother, more efficient task management experience.

title: Smarter Collaboration, Smoother Workflow
summary: Experience a significantly more intuitive and seamless way to collaborate with your team, boosting collective productivity and shared understanding.

title: Enhanced Collaboration for Shared Items
summary: We've made it simpler to discover and utilize shared content, ensuring all relevant items you have access to are easily found through search and within your network.

title: Global Language Support
summary: Noeko is expanding to support multiple international languages, making it accessible to a global audience.

title: Noeko is Now Open Source!
summary: Noeko's codebase is now open source, empowering our community with greater transparency, control, and direct involvement in shaping its future.

title: Enhanced Constellation View
summary: Explore your knowledge base with unprecedented clarity and efficiency, using powerful new filters and sharing options within the enhanced Constellation View.

title: Dynamic Search and Personalized Knowledge Collections
summary: Effortlessly pinpoint specific information and create personalized knowledge collections using dynamic search filters for unparalleled organization and discovery.

title: Dynamic Note Layouts
summary: Organize your thoughts with dynamic note layouts and interactive content previews that adapt to your unique workflow.

title: Noeko Goes Public: Self-Hosting and Premium Plans
summary: Soon, you'll be able to host Noeko on your own infrastructure or choose from our new flexible premium plans, giving you more control and powerful features to elevate your workflow.

title: Vibrant New Themes & Polished Classics
summary: Discover a refreshed collection of beautifully designed themes, offering more personalization options and visual appeal for everyone.

title: Smart Welcome Messages
summary: Our updated greetings will always reflect the accurate time of day, enhancing your personalized experience on the homepage.

title: Direct Actions for Efficient List Management
summary: Perform essential actions like unapplying tags, deleting items, and viewing details directly from your lists, empowering you to manage your content with greater speed and convenience.

title: Connect More of Your Favorite Content
summary: Empower your workflow by easily integrating and annotating content from a diverse array of sources, such as videos, websites, and text, all within one powerful platform.
